text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I run, I just 
can't... catch the wind...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Why does my body feel so heavy...? Just 
what could be the cause――

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Do you mean 'heavy' in a literal, 
physical sense? I suppose I have been 
eating a bit too much lately...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, to become the wind, I really must 
become lighter..."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To become a gently blowing fresh breeze, I 
must endeavor with all my might...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In her quest to become the wind, Yamanin 
Zephyr put in the effort and successfully 
dieted.
